description: This file defines the ScriptExternalLoginEventHandler class which implements external login event handling, including generating usernames via scripting and synchronizing user properties and roles based on scripts, within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: ScriptExternalLoginEventHandler
classes.description: Handles external login events, generating usernames and updating user properties via scripting.

methods.name: GenerateUserName
methods.description: Generates a username based on external claims and scripting if enabled in settings.

methods.name: UpdateUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates user information based on external login, retrieving settings and invoking internal update logic.

methods.name: UpdateUserInternal
methods.description: Synchronizes user roles, claims, and properties using scripting if enabled in settings.
